section_summary: This section is an index followed by charts on public health and welfare in Japan. The charts cover disease rates, births and deaths, hospitals, public assistance, nutrition, social insurance, and production and distribution of medical supplies, chiefly through 1948.

subfiles.title: Public Health and Welfare in Japan: Index to Charts
subfiles.about: Lists the subjects and numbers of the public health and welfare charts.
subfiles.summary: Indexes charts on health, welfare, nutrition, hospitals, and medical supplies.

subfiles.title: Public Health and Welfare Section, GHQ, SCAP
subfiles.about: Shows the divisions and branches of the occupation's Public Health and Welfare Section.
subfiles.summary: Maps the section's administrative, medical, preventive health, nursing, supply, and welfare units.

subfiles.title: Ministry of Welfare
subfiles.about: Shows the bureaus, agencies, institutes, and branches of Japan's Ministry of Welfare.
subfiles.summary: Details the ministry's health, medical, insurance, child welfare, relief, and repatriation structure.

subfiles.title: Smallpox—Japan, 1938–1948
subfiles.about: Plots monthly and yearly smallpox case and death rates in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Compares smallpox cases and deaths across 1938–1948.

subfiles.title: Typhus Fever—Japan, 1938–1948
subfiles.about: Plots monthly and yearly typhus case and death rates in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Compares typhus cases and deaths across 1938–1948.

subfiles.title: Diphtheria—Japan, 1938–1948
subfiles.about: Plots monthly and yearly diphtheria case and death rates in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Compares diphtheria cases and deaths across 1938–1948.

subfiles.title: Dysentery, 1938–1948

subfiles.summary: Compares dysentery cases and deaths across 1938–1948.

subfiles.title: Typhoid Fever—Japan, 1938–1948

subfiles.summary: Compares typhoid cases and deaths across 1938–1948.

subfiles.title: Comparative Tuberculosis Death Rates
subfiles.about: Compares tuberculosis death rates in Japan and several Western countries.

subfiles.title: Death Rates from Tuberculosis According to Age: Japan, 1916–1943, 1947
subfiles.about: Compares Japanese tuberculosis death rates for ages 10–24, other ages, and the total population.
subfiles.summary: Shows age-group tuberculosis mortality over time.

subfiles.title: Venereal Diseases—Japan
subfiles.about: Plots reported syphilis, gonorrhea, and chancroid rates during 1946–1948.

subfiles.title: Death Rate by Month: Japan, 1946–1948

subfiles.title: Civilian Hospital Patients: Japan, 1946–1948

subfiles.title: Japanese Feudal Relief Program, ?–1860
subfiles.about: Diagrams historical sources of relief for needy people in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Shows relationships among the emperor, religious institutions, families, and the needy.

subfiles.title: Institutions under Ministry of Welfare
subfiles.about: Compares inmates and capacity across Ministry of Welfare institutions.
subfiles.summary: Includes homes for children, mothers, infants, aged people, and people with disabilities.

subfiles.title: Current Welfare Program
subfiles.about: Diagrams public and private participants in assistance to needy families.
subfiles.summary: Shows national, prefectural, municipal, religious, and charitable welfare channels.

subfiles.title: Persons Receiving Public Assistance
subfiles.about: Tracks institutional and noninstitutional recipients of public assistance.

subfiles.title: Cost of Public Assistance
subfiles.about: Tracks cash and in-kind assistance costs and average expenditure per noninstitutional recipient.
subfiles.summary: Plots public assistance spending from 1946 into 1949.

subfiles.title: Average Weight of Primary School Children in Thirty-Three Urban Schools in Japan, 1937–1947
subfiles.about: Shows average weights of urban primary school children by age and sex.

subfiles.title: Average Weight of Primary School Children in Thirty-Three Rural Schools in Japan, 1937–1947

subfiles.title: Social Insurances
subfiles.about: Compares Japanese insurance laws, coverage, administration, contributions, and benefits.
subfiles.summary: Lists health, pension, unemployment, accident, and government employee schemes.

subfiles.title: Caloric Consumption—Japan, 1945–1947 Nutrition Surveys
